rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose rendering when something is scheduled or expected to happen, including a baby expected to be born.

example.english: The baby is due to be born next month.
example.traditional: 個嬰兒預計會喺下個月出世。
example.jyutping: go3 jing1 ji4 jyu6 gai3 wui5 hai2 haa6 go3 jyut6 ceot1 sai3

rows.note: Use this when someone is entitled to receive money, time, or another benefit that is owed.

example.english: We are due this overtime pay.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jing1 dak1 ni1 bat1 gaa1 baan1 cin2

rows.note: Use this for something that is proper or appropriate in the circumstances.

example.english: Now is the appropriate time to pay the rent, and the rent is due today.
example.traditional: 而家係適當時間交租，今日租金亦都到期喇。
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 hai6 sik1 dong3 si4 gaan3 gaau1 zou1 gam1 jat6 zou1 gam1 jik6 dou1 dou3 kei4 laa3

rows.note: Use this only for an exact compass direction, meaning directly north.

example.english: The compass is due north, not northeast.
example.traditional: 指南針指住正北，唔係東北。
example.jyutping: zi2 naam4 zam1 zi2 zyu6 zing3 bak1 m4 hai6 dung1 bak1
